prompt: Bug in the audit log query (apollo-audit). `ApolloAuditLogService.findByOpNameAndTime(opName, startDate, endDate, page, size)` always queries with both a lower and an upper date bound, so callers that pass `null` for startDate and/or endDate (open-ended filters from the UI) get no results or an error. Support open-ended filters: no dates → filter by opName only; only startDate → created time >= startDate; only endDate → created time <= endDate; both → between. Keep paging and newest-first sorting, and document the null semantics in `ApolloAuditLogQueryApi`.

oracle_plan.instruction: Document that startDate/endDate may be null meaning no lower/upper bound.
In findByOpNameAndTime, dispatch to findByOpName / >= / <= / between depending on which dates are null.
